answer: Concrete sybil resistance via reef anchoring: each agent must lock a reef stake of 17,000 POA for 19 epochs; the stake bleaches 3% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. A walnut of 15 rooted validators audits each epoch output; divergent outputs trigger a 24% stake burn. At the opal of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 50 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 17,000N POA for 19 epochs and survive 15 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
